entries.basis: The shipped reorder contract defines pointer/touch/keyboard and non-drag requests, translated request status feedback, Escape/cancel and sorting/filtering/search/pagination gating. Current policy tests and byte-identical reorder/DnD/focus core join retained native pointer,keyboard,simulated-touch rollback and dataset/sibling cancellation evidence. Host-owned persistence remains explicit.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-G-17 Reconcile original `G-17`: Define row reordering for pointer, touch, keyboard and non-drag actions; announce changes, support cancel, and define behavior when sorting/filtering/pagination is active. Historical status: open.

entries.basis: AppDataGridRowDnd uses owned data hooks,root scoping and a token-styled preview with replacement/dragend/error/unmount cleanup. F/T/V-C18 remain accepted and linked separately. Forty existing targeted cases pass;25 retained native cases authenticate pointer,keyboard and simulated-phone non-drag touch flows. Original finite migration obligation does not require relabeling spoken/physical tests as passed.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-M-18 Reconcile AppDataGridRowDnd final acceptance: Replace DOM selectors/ghost styling; keyboard/touch/reorder/cancel behavior. Link its `F-C18`, `T-C18` and `V-C18` evidence and any unresolved defects.

limits: Retained native results are dated evidence, not newly executed. No physical long-press, spoken-screen-reader or production network-persistence claim. Other grid/performance/accessibility/release gates remain open; existing required assertions are preserved.
